pages.title: A Chill Down the Spine
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: This is an optional challenge in the creature’s native setting. Obtain access and summon it normally; it does not replace the main campaign.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Defeat a Frostomper and collect its meat. The large mammoth supplies Beast Chops.
